name: Honey Hill Farms
tagline: A piece of heaven called Honey Hill Farms
description: Honey Hill Farms is a working farm in Mayfield, KY. It grows Pumpkins, Flowers, Sunflowers, and Honey, with seasonal availability through autumn. The harvest is typically at its peak in autumn. Check the website or call ahead for current hours and what is in season.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Sep – Nov in this growing zone.
